subject.title: typedocs-only PR to help others avoid kubernetes OOM-kills

question: Should the shared Kubernetes manifest ship a fixed `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536` default, or should this PR be narrowed to optional operator guidance?
rationale: This changes the runtime environment inherited by Kubernetes deployments, and the safe default depends on maintainer intent for the public manifest rather than on CI alone.

options.title: Correct wording and prove default
options.body: Keep the fixed heap cap only after the contributor corrects the Node/cgroup explanation and posts redacted Kubernetes proof that the reported pod no longer exits 137.

options.title: Accept fixed default deliberately
options.body: Ship the 1536 MiB cap as a maintained Kubernetes default and own the operator-facing requirement to update it when the memory limit changes.

options.title: Narrow to optional guidance
options.body: Remove the manifest default and document `NODE_OPTIONS` as an operator-applied overlay for memory-limited clusters.

recommendation.title: Correct wording and prove default
recommendation.body: Keep the fixed heap cap only after the contributor corrects the Node/cgroup explanation and posts redacted Kubernetes proof that the reported pod no longer exits 137.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent docs/manifests ownership makes this the best available routing candidate for the shared install-manifest default decision.
